categories.main_business_segments: Beijing LongRuan Technologies Inc. primarily operates in the development and provision of industrial software and digital intelligent solutions for the mining industry, especially coal mining. Its main business includes the LongRuan GIS platform, intelligent mining industrial software, smart safety supervision, smart emergency systems, and digital twin technology applications. The company also extends its solutions to non-coal mining, zero-carbon airports, and industrial parks.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary LongRuan GIS spatial information platform technology, integrating cloud computing, big data, artificial intelligence (AI), digital twin, industrial internet, and IoT technologies. It develops software based on a service-oriented architecture supporting 2D/3D GIS, temporal GIS, and cloud-native microservices. The company also focuses on AI spatial-temporal large models, video AI recognition, and digital twin engines for mining safety and operational control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large state-owned coal mining enterprises, government emergency management and safety supervision departments, research institutions, industrial parks, and high-risk industry enterprises. The company serves primarily the coal mining sector but also targets non-coal mining, energy, and public safety sectors. Its products are widely used in national smart coal mine demonstration projects and various mining groups across China.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters in Beijing and subsidiaries in regions including Shanxi, Guizhou, Inner Mongolia, Hebei, and Ordos. It has established regional centers and service outlets covering major coal-producing provinces such as Shanxi, Inner Mongolia, Shaanxi, Xinjiang, and others. The company is also expanding international business with initial focus on Russia and Africa.
categories.supply_chain_position: Beijing LongRuan Technologies operates primarily in the midstream segment of the mining industry supply chain, focusing on software development and system integration for mining operations and safety management. It provides industrial software platforms and digital solutions that support upstream mining production and downstream safety supervision and emergency response.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous innovation in AI spatial-temporal large models, digital twin technology, cloud GIS, and industrial internet integration. It emphasizes original development of its LongRuan GIS platform and advanced intelligent mining solutions, including the '6626' advanced intelligent mine construction project. Strategic R&D collaborations with Beijing University and other institutes focus on mining disaster simulation, AI-driven decision support, and smart mining equipment control.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of industrial software products, customized software development, technical services, system integration, and hardware sales. The company is transitioning from license-based sales to subscription-based cloud GIS services. It also earns income from government subsidies and investment returns.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in the domestic intelligent mining software market, with a market penetration rate exceeding 85% in coal mining GIS installations and participation in 46 out of 71 national smart coal mine demonstration projects. It competes with other software providers and system integrators in the mining and industrial software sectors but benefits from strong proprietary technology and extensive industry experience.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total revenue of approximately RMB 328.6 million, a 17% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 33 million, down 60.8%. Despite revenue decline due to delayed customer demand and increased R&D investment, cash flow from operations turned positive with a net inflow of RMB 21.9 million. The company maintains a solid asset base with total assets of about RMB 940 million and equity of RMB 741 million, showing steady growth in net assets.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Beijing LongRuan Technologies emphasizes its fully自主研发 (independently developed) LongRuan GIS platform with complete intellectual property rights, offering high-performance, cross-platform, and国产化 (domestically controlled) industrial software solutions. Its products integrate advanced AI, digital twin, and spatial-temporal intelligence technologies tailored for complex mining environments, providing comprehensive, real-time, and intelligent mining safety and production management. The company’s solutions enable safer, more efficient, and greener mining operations, supported by strong R&D and strategic academic partnerships.
